newsitem.title: USA: Forest says FDA not satisfied on Infasurf.
newsitem.headline: Forest says FDA not satisfied on Infasurf.

text.p: Forest Laboratories Inc said Monday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration had not yet accepted the company's position that Infasurf is a different drug than Abbott Laboratories Inc's Survanta for purposes of Orphan Drug regulations.
Forest said the agency suggested it perform additional studies on Infasurf.
Infasurf is intended for treating distress syndrome in premature infants.
The FDA previously granted tentative approval for Infasurf but delayed marketing approval until the expiration of Survanta's Orphan Drug exclusivity in July 1998, Forest said.
Forest today reported slightly lower fiscal first quarter net sales. It blamed recent sales weakness on destocking of wholesaler inventories. It also reported lower earnings.
